authorization.permitted: The host Codex session may execute the exact pinned bootstrap runner as deterministic orchestrator preparation, then change role to WU-05 implementer only after readiness. No separate human merge action is required.
not_permitted: running a package-only validator from the unprepared implementation tree

supersedes: earlier bootstrap-v2 clause prohibiting all Codex-owned branch preparation
earlier prompts that assume orchestrator preparation already happened
root_cause: The old validator command is absent by design at the preserved review commit; bootstrap and implementation roles must not be interchanged.
bootstrap_protocol: obtain the exact external publication SHA
locate and inspect the preserved worktree without switching branches
fetch and extract the runner with git show from the pinned commit
reject non-control package delta; validate real dependencies in a detached worktree
require zero exits AND all structured PASS markers before merge
merge with ordered parents [preserved_review, exact_package] or revalidate that exact existing clean merge
preserve command logs outside tracked working tree
start WU-05 source repair only after LOCAL_WU05_AUTHORITY_READY

failure_modes.trigger: invoke absent package validator before preparation
successful bootstrap rerun is treated as authority corruption

retry_policy: Only the original clean review or its exact clean two-parent merge is accepted. No newer implementation commit is rewound. Post-merge failures preserve the merge and logs.
integrity_model: Externally pinned commit/tree identify source/control bytes. Existing historical manifests remain unchanged; this revision does not add a new manifest gate. Package metadata drift is not a scientific failure.
review_policy: The existing one fresh-context repair review and final differential audit remain. No additional review layer.

integrations.atlassian_outage: ATLAS_SYNC_PENDING, never a source-repair success claim

prohibited: campaign replay without distinct semantic/evidence reason
